item.title: AI Stocks Daily — Oct 21, 2026
item.description: Ken Griffin: AI 'almost certainly' in a bubble; Ed Zitron on concentration risk and why an equities bubble can't be bailed out; Citi's Dirk Willer: neocloud stress fractures are a financing problem, not the end; the 2000 analogy and the OpenAI/Anthropic black box; Nvidia's 40-50% revenue concentration; Elon's 'yikes' on CoreWeave's 15% debt yields and the $1.6T AI-stock wipeout; Australia's NEXTDC -42% on a power-grid freeze; Nvidia's $35B China order (5-10% fillable); the compute-constrained bull case through 2028; Nvidia's Vera CPU winning Modal from Intel/AMD, LPDDR5X demand for Micron.

item.title: AI Stocks Daily — Oct 20, 2026
item.description: Bubble: Stoic Finance on the Ellis AI IPO crashing 32% on day one, neocloud financing fears, CoreWeave bond yields at 15%; InvestorPlace debate — Eric says the AI trade is long in the tooth, an asymmetrical trade, broad market topped in August; Market Signal — 10 companies carry 68% of S&P Q3 earnings growth (Goldman), cheap multiples rest on huge forecasts, Piper's $300 Nvidia target at 14x 2028 earnings. Supply/demand: FinVid rebuts the 'more supply than demand' analyst claim — token price cuts aren't demand weakness, GPU rentals robust; Julian Whatley — AI buildout raising electric bills, PJM capacity prices up 10x ($28.92 to $329.17), paying before the future arrives. Watchlist: CNBC's Gil Luria (D.A. Davidson) — Anthropic growth slowdown doesn't matter, profit pools accrue to NVDA/Broadcom/Micron/AMD; FinVid news — Nvidia asks Samsung/SK Hynix/Micron for NVHBM base dies on TSMC 3nm, Microsoft UK data center pullout over power delays (23K GPUs), Anthropic $45B compute deal doubling, Micron Taiwan strike vote and $33B buyback; Dan Ives — Nvidia numbers underestimated 25-30%, Asia checks accelerating; Jose Najarro — Meta's 1M-GPU supercluster, GB300 reliability gains, power the binding bottleneck (170kW racks).

item.title: AI Stocks Daily — Oct 19, 2026
item.description: Channel 4 News (former US financial regulator): AI retrenchment in 18-30 months, the math isn't working; neocloud breakages and data-center debt backing into the financial system. Smerconish/Walter Isaacson: railroad-bubble analogy, 250 rail companies went bankrupt. MarketBeat/Dan Ives: AI buildout expensive, token costs falling, hyperscaler monetization inflection; AMD the darling, Intel surprise. Motley Fool: Lumentum can't meet 70% of demand, sold out into 2029; Broadcom 'anti-Nvidia', $30 EPS 2028, AI revenue doubling. Stas Talks Stocks: relief-rally rundown NVDA/MU/LRCX/TSM/GLW/SNDK. TheTeslaGuy: semi earnings cross-impact, AMD/AVGO/TSM levels. Options With Ryan: TSM assigned at 432.50 below 50-day MA.
